content.short: Mendi Finance is the primary decentralized lending protocol on Linea, offering interest-bearing markets for assets.
content.description: Mendi Finance is the leading non-custodial decentralized lending platform built natively for the Linea network. The protocol allows users to supply various digital assets to earn interest and borrow against them as collateral in a transparent, peer-to-peer environment. Designed for maximum capital efficiency and security, Mendi Finance provides essential financial infrastructure for the Linea ecosystem, enabling participants to manage their liquidity with institutional-grade precision. Powered by the MENDI token, the protocol features a sustainable revenue-sharing model on Linea.
